story.title: Add a child dependent under age 26
story.description: An 834 ADD names a child whose age is under 26. The child is stored with relationship CHILD and the same plan as the subscriber.
acceptanceCriteria: A child aged 0 through 25 is accepted as a dependent.
The child coverage effective date matches the date on the enrollment.

retrievedContext.title: enrollment business rules
retrievedContext.text: Example Benefit Plan, invented for practice. An ADD for relationship SPOUSE is accepted when the subscriber is active, and the subscriber coverage date stays unchanged. A child aged 0 through 25 with relationship CHILD is accepted. Relationship CHILD at age 26 or older is rejected. TERM for the subscriber ends every dependent on the contract. A relationship other than SPOUSE or CHILD is rejected.
